The '''2014–15 Houston Cougars men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Houston]] during the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. It was their first season under head coach [[Kelvin Sampson]]<ref name=Sampson>[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/10716634/kelvin-sampson-coach-houston-cougars?ex_cid=espnapi_public Cougars hire Kelvin Sampson], ESPN.com, retrieved 29 May 2014</ref> and second as members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. The Cougars’ home arena was the on-campus [[Hofheinz Pavilion]]. Their record was 13–19, and 4–14 in conference play to finish in tenth place. They advanced to the quarterfinals of the [[2015 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|2015 American Conference tournament]], where they lost to Tulsa.

==Schedule and results==
On May 28, the American Athletic Conference announced the format and opponents for the 2014–15 conference schedule. Due to an odd number of conference members and maintaining an 18-game schedule, each team played 8 opponents twice (home and away) and two opponents once (1 home, 1 away). UConn (home) and Temple (away) were the two teams the Cougars played just once this season.<ref name=Schedule>[http://theamerican.org/news/2014/5/28/MBB_0528141816.aspx 2014-15 Men's Basketball Schedule Format Announced], TheAmerican.org, retrieved 29 May 2014</ref> On July 18, the team announced participation in the championship pairings of the 2014 Continental Tire Las Vegas Classic, alongside [[2014–15 Boise State Broncos men's basketball team|Boise State]], [[2014–15 Texas Tech Red Raiders basketball team|Texas Tech]], and [[2014–15 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola–Chicago]] at the Orleans Arena. Two on-campus games preceded the Las Vegas-hosted games,<ref name=Continental>[http://www.uhcougars.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/071814aaf.html Men's Basketball to Compete at Continental Tire Las Vegas Classic], UHCougars.com, retrieved 23 June 2014</ref> with one at South Carolina State.<ref>[http://www.scsuathletics.com/news/2014/7/24/MBBSchedule.aspx SC State Men's Basketball Releases 2014-15 Schedule], retrieved 16 August 2014</ref>  In August, ESPN reported that Houston's visit to Harvard for a game on November 25.<ref>[https://www.espn.com/blog/boston/colleges/post/_/id/5350/harvard-hoops-schedule-in-focus Harvard Hoops Schedule in Focus], retrieved 16 August 2014</ref> The remainder of the Cougars' schedule was announced by the American Athletic Conference on August 28.<ref name=FinalSch>[http://www.theamerican.org/news/2014/8/28/MBB_0828143737.aspx American Athletic Conference Announces 2014-15 Men's Basketball Schedule], TheAmerican.org, retrieved 30 August 2014</ref>
